| [`animations/background-image-interpolation.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/css/css-backgrounds/animations/background-image-interpolation.html) | Fail | 420 / 492 | BUG | 72 of 492 subtests: `background-image` (and `list-style-image`) is transitioned without `transition-behavior: allow-discrete` (`CssInterpolationKind.Image` in `CssAnimationTypes.cs` is not discrete for `CssInterpolation.Prepare`), so the transitions show the start value before the middle; its animation type is discrete (https://drafts.csswg.org/css-backgrounds-3/#background-image), and a discrete property does not transition without `allow-discrete` (https://drafts.csswg.org/css-transitions-2/#transition-behavior-property), as the test expects since web-platform-tests/wpt commit 24c4209 (WebKit 322918, "as is needed for discrete only properties"). Making the image kind discrete passes the test, but other tests still expect the image transitions and fail then: the transition subtests of `css/css-lists/animations/list-style-image-interpolation.html` (`list-style-image` is discrete too, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-lists-3/#image-markers) and the 3 `background-image ... / events` subtests of `css/css-transitions/properties-value-003.html` (their `transitionend` event): the fix has to reclassify them as TEST BUG at the same time |
